title: Interpolating walk between discrete-time quantum walk and its intrinsic random walk on graph
summary: We consider an interpolation with the parameter $p\in [0,1]$ between the discrete-time quantum ($p=0$) and its intrinsic random ($p=1$) walks on a finite connected graph. Its time evolution is defined by the convex combination of the Kraus (CPTP) maps of the quantum and random walks. The Kraus map of the random walk is represented by taking a kind of projection of that of the quantum walk.
